in_marathi.name: Gauranga
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant with the inner glow of the Supreme Lord
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gauranga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gauranga is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'radiant with the inner glow of the Supreme Lord Vishnu'. It is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual depth and divine connection. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is often depicted as having a golden complexion, signifying the inner light of the divine. Gauranga is a name that embodies this idea of inner radiance and divine connection.
